visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a goatee wearing a black baseball cap, black t-shirt, and blue denim overalls stands in front of a pegboard wall filled with various power tools. He waves and gestures with his hands towards the camera. (2) A man with short hair and a beard wearing a yellow tank top stands indoors with his eyes closed and hands pressed together in a prayer gesture. (3) A close-up shot shows a hand turning a metallic window handle and sliding the window open. (4) Through an open window, a hazy outdoor landscape with trees is visible, suggesting poor air quality. (5) A person with their hair tied back is shown putting on and adjusting a blue surgical mask. (6) A tall industrial chimney with red and white stripes emits a thick plume of white smoke into a blue sky. (7) The man in overalls returns, gesturing towards the screen as a yellow variety text box appears. (8) Technical documents and experimental reports with Chinese text are shown as overlays on the screen. (9) A close-up magnified view of a dark mesh screen shows its fine grid structure. (10) A man in a white button-down shirt is seen holding and reading papers with a distressed and confused facial expression. (11) Glass doors in a high-tech facility or server room slide shut automatically. (12) The man in overalls continues to explain, using expansive hand motions to indicate a physical space. (13) A schematic diagram of a technical experiment involving HEPA filters and dust tracking is displayed. (14) A line graph with data points and error bars is shown, illustrating efficiency percentages against air velocity. (15) The man holds up a small black window frame containing a mesh screen sample. (16) A digital handheld meter labeled Simco FMX-004 is pressed against the black mesh; a red light flashes and the digital display shows values dropping from 8.5 to 6.0. (17) The same meter is pressed against a standard window screen, showing a reading of +0.00 kV on the digital display. (18) The man holds a blue duster tool and demonstrates a sweeping motion to illustrate electrostatic attraction. (19) A close-up shot focuses on a small silver branding plate on the mesh frame that says 'AIM'. (20) The man holds the AIM product frame, looking directly into the camera while concluding his explanation.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Problem Identification -> Myth-busting -> Solution Evidence -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves to educate consumers on the common misconceptions surrounding '99.9% blocking' anti-haze window screens, specifically highlighting how their effectiveness is often tested in windless conditions that do not reflect real-world use. It then introduces and promotes the AIM brand's electrostatic screen technology as a scientifically backed solution, providing visual evidence through digital meter measurements of static charge.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator wears a branded outfit, uses the product name multiple times in subtitles and slogans, and demonstrates the product's unique selling point (electrostatic charge) compared to standard screens.
